_description: Fitted coefficients — output of the fitting pipeline (tools/fit/). Regenerated by scripts, not edited manually. Plan 09 (steps 2–7a) deleted every fitted comb family this file carried — the obliquity, year-length, perihelion, Sun-longitude and RA-day-offset combs on divisors of the unit, and last the frozen cardinal record CARDINAL_POINT_HARMONICS / _ANCHORS / _ANCHORS_ADJUSTED / _ECC_TERMS / _DERIVED / _JOINT_TERMS with its phase-origin notes (plan 07 R10). The movement is one source: the certified Sun's crossings, the hybrid obliquity, the series' perihelion, the one-family year laws. Git history carries the coefficients; docs/110 §5.2/§5.5 the frozen record. The shipped fitted artifacts live under data/ (the ΔT stack, the core-mantle resonator, the climate formula) and are embedded by tools/constants/generate.mjs.
